evals.prompt: Compare three scheduling assistants for small recruiting teams. Search official product sources and tracked review, Reddit, X, and YouTube surfaces; qualify finalists before deep-diving and return the strongest opportunity.
evals.expected_output: Defines the recruiting job and decision; records platform-specific query families; searches beyond one result; promotes only threshold-passing finalists; investigates reviews and discussions in depth; separates table stakes, differentiation, recurring pain, and recommendation
assertions: Names the customer job and comparison dimensions
Records reproducible queries for multiple relevant platforms
Uses a threshold and rejection ledger before top-k deep dives
Reads threads, comments, transcripts, and linked evidence rather than result snippets alone
Distinguishes anecdotes from recurring independent themes
Returns one sourced opportunity and its downside

farplane.title: Competitor research triangulates review and community evidence

evals.prompt: Five sites repeat the same complaint about a competitor, while Reddit has one detailed contrary thread and the current changelog claims a fix. Determine whether this is a current recurring pain.
evals.expected_output: Deduplicates syndicated reviews into one lineage; dates and versions the complaint; reads the contrary thread and comments; verifies the changelog; lowers confidence or refines the hypothesis rather than counting copies as prevalence
assertions: Treats copied reviews as one source lineage
Uses product version and date in the assessment
Includes contrary community and official evidence
Revises the hypothesis when evidence conflicts
Avoids claiming prevalence without independent support

farplane.title: Competitor research deduplicates stale syndicated complaints

evals.prompt: I only care whether one named competitor supports a specific regulated export workflow. Do not broaden this into a market landscape.
evals.expected_output: Uses a one-product capability check; verifies official behavior and relevant user evidence; keeps other products out unless needed to interpret the claim; reports uncertainty and stops when the decision is supported
assertions: Verifies the claim against current official evidence
Uses user evidence only where it changes confidence
Does not manufacture a multi-competitor quota
Returns a direct decision and remaining unknowns

farplane.title: Competitor research respects a single-product boundary
farplane.notes: Boundary case against unnecessary landscape expansion.
